title: Only 5% Avoid Metric—Yet Conversion Errors Downed A Plane
hook: Only 5% avoid metric, but one conversion emptied a plane.
closing: Unit checks feel tedious until one conversion turns routine work into an emergency.
question: Should every country use metric?

segments.say: Only 5 percent live in non-metric countries. A small holdout still creates dangerous conversion points.
A metric mix-up dropped the Mars orbiter to 57 kilometers. It flew far below the planned path.
A metric error left the plane 55 percent short on fuel. It ran dry and had to glide down.
